name: Permanent Residence Permit under Regulation 6(2) (Category F / 6.2)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a minimum qualifying investment of EUR 300,000 in one of several categories (new-build residential real estate as a first sale from a developer, commercial property, Cyprus company shares with 5 employees and a physical presence, or units in a regulated investment fund), with funds transferred to Cyprus from abroad.
requirements.fix_path: Fund the qualifying investment and document the transfer of funds from abroad.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a secure annual income of at least EUR 50,000 from abroad for the main applicant, plus EUR 15,000 for a spouse and EUR 10,000 per minor child.
requirements.fix_path: Document qualifying annual income from abroad.

evidence_required.document: Proof of investment and bank transfer of funds from abroad
Proof of secure annual income from abroad (bank statements, dividends, salary, pension, rentals)

outcome.duration_length: indefinite (subject to the holder not remaining outside Cyprus for an extended period)
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: must visit Cyprus at least once every 2 years to avoid revocation; no minimum days/year required to hold the permit

sources.title: Mondaq -- Cyprus Permanent Residency Under Regulation 6(2) (Category 6.2): A Comprehensive Legal Guide

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Cyprus's initial build. This is Cyprus's main investment-migration route today, distinct from the discontinued cy_citizenship_by_investment -- it grants PERMANENT RESIDENCE directly (not citizenship), with citizenship only reachable afterward through ordinary naturalisation (cy_naturalisation), which still requires its own years-of-residence test. work_rights set 'restricted': holders may not be employed in Cyprus (a defining, deliberate restriction of this residence category to keep it distinct from work-based routes) but may serve as directors of their own Cyprus company or engage in certain passive activities.
